tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Public overview of Seattle Organic SEO and its services. Read only.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Get public contact details and the contact page URL. Does not submit a lead.

tools.name: list_public_pages
tools.description: List known public site pages that the agent can read.

tools.name: read_public_page
tools.description: Read text from a known public page. Returns origin errors rather than fabricating content.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_contact_info · Private data: get_contact_info · Public sink: get_contact_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_contact_info · Private data: get_contact_info · Public sink: get_contact_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
